summary: Describes the Reconciliation Service that continuously matches internal ledger entries against counterparty acknowledgements using a tuple-based matching algorithm. Implements break classification based on tolerance bands (0.01% domestic, 0.05% cross-border), auto-resolution logic for small discrepancies, duplicate detection, and escalation workflows.

likely_libraries.name: Reconciliation
likely_libraries.reason: Major system capability for matching and reconciling ledger entries with counterparties, implementing tolerance-based break classification and auto-resolution logic
